title: Text Reuse Passage Schema
description: Schema for text reuse passage properties within a content item

beg_offset_i.title: Start offset of TR passage
beg_offset_i.description: Start character offset (index) of the TR passage, relative to the content item transcript.

end_offset_i.title: End offset of TR passage
end_offset_i.description: End character offset (index) of the TR passage, relative to the content item transcript.

cluster_id_s.title: Cluster ID
cluster_id_s.description: Unique identifier for the text reuse cluster this passage belongs to

cluster_size_l.title: Cluster size
cluster_size_l.description: Number of passages in this text reuse cluster

cluster_lex_overlap_d.title: Cluster lexical overlap
cluster_lex_overlap_d.description: Lexical overlap percentage for the cluster

cluster_day_delta_i.title: Cluster day delta
cluster_day_delta_i.description: Number of days between the earliest and latest documents in the cluster

connected_clusters_ss.title: Connected clusters
connected_clusters_ss.description: List of cluster IDs that are connected to this cluster

n_connected_clusters_i.title: Number of connected clusters
n_connected_clusters_i.description: Count of clusters connected to this cluster
